title: Bindings Policy
description: policies/bindings.yaml — role -> skill binding declarations per harness (docs/skills-design.md §4, spec Appendix G.1, docs/integrations.md §2/§5). Single source of truth for which skills (Layer 1 contract skills and Layer 2 vendored skills) back each role; consumed by `agent skills install`, `agent task claim`/`start`, and `agent validate`. Owner: repo-maintainer role. Staleness trigger: a referenced skill path that stops resolving to a SKILL.md (in the target repo or the packaged skills tree) fails `agent validate` — fix the path or the pack, or remove the binding; do not leave it broken.

roles.description: One entry per role id (docs/DESIGN.md §2 roles/, spec Appendix F). A role may be omitted entirely if it has no binding; role ids not in this enum are rejected to catch typos.

active_harness.description: Default harness used to resolve `skills` recommendations printed at `agent task claim`/`start`, and the default target for `agent skills install` when --harness is omitted.

install.description: Optional per-harness discovery-path overrides for `agent skills install` (defaults: claude-code -> .claude/skills, cursor -> .cursor/skills; generic writes .agent/skills-index.md instead of copying files, so a generic override names that index file's directory).

startup_skills.description: Skill paths (repo-root-relative into the platform's skills tree, e.g. 'skills/worker-startup') printed by `agent task claim`/`start` as 'Required before work begins' for tasks bound to this role. Harness-neutral: these are not per-harness.

skills.description: Harness-recommended skill paths for this role (informational for the agent; gates do the enforcing, never skill presence alone).
